## validatePositionHealth() function

Validates that the resulting position stays within the safe LTV threshold (LLTV minus buffer) after supplying additional collateral and borrowing.

**Signature:**

```typescript
validatePositionHealth: (params: {
    positionData: AccrualPosition;
    additionalCollateral: bigint;
    borrowAmount: bigint;
    marketId: MarketId;
    lltv: bigint;
}) => void
```

Parameter details:
